{
  "name": "loss_softplus_001_advantage",
  "intuition": "Use a pairwise softplus loss that penalizes the negative margin between winning and losing log probabilities, modulated by the advantage signal, encouraging the model to amplify better-ranked outputs more smoothly.",
  "pseudocode": "margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l; weighted_margin = advantage_gap * margin; loss = mean(weight * softplus(-weighted_margin))",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_smooth_margin",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "softplus",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "softplus",
    "sub",
    "mul",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    weighted_margin = ops.mul(adv_gap, margin)\n    loss = ops.softplus(ops.neg(weighted_margin))\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_001_cost_sumagg",
  "intuition": "Apply pairwise logsigmoid loss with a cost gap adjustment, aggregating losses by summation instead of mean to emphasize total error magnitude.",
  "pseudocode": "x = clamp(alpha*scale*(log_prob_w - log_prob_l) - 0.1*(cost_b - cost_a), -20, 20)\nloss_i = -logsigmoid(x_i) * weight_i\nloss = sum(loss_i)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "scale": 1.9496803035382082,
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_margin",
    "signal_family": "cost_gap",
    "link_family": "logsigmoid",
    "agg_family": "sum",
    "constraint_family": "clamp_stabilized"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "logsigmoid",
    "clamp",
    "sum",
    "mul",
    "sub"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "cost_a",
      "cost_b"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.sum(loss)"
}
